deliveries_scheduled_window_check.name: deliveries_scheduled_window_check
deliveries_scheduled_window_check.value: "deliveries"."scheduled_to" IS NULL OR "deliveries"."scheduled_from" IS NULL OR "deliveries"."scheduled_to" >= "deliveries"."scheduled_from"

food_intents_desired_date_range_check.name: food_intents_desired_date_range_check
food_intents_desired_date_range_check.value: "food_intents"."desired_date_end" IS NULL OR "food_intents"."desired_date" IS NULL OR "food_intents"."desired_date_end" >= "food_intents"."desired_date"

household_invitations_invitee_identity_c.name: household_invitations_invitee_identity_check
household_invitations_invitee_identity_c.value: "household_invitations"."invitee_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "household_invitations"."invitee_email" IS NOT NULL

household_members_removed_at_consistency.name: household_members_removed_at_consistency
household_members_removed_at_consistency.value: ("household_members"."status" = 'active' AND "household_members"."removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("household_members"."status" = 'removed' AND "household_members"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)

memory_sync_records_scope_owner_check.name: memory_sync_records_scope_owner_check
memory_sync_records_scope_owner_check.value: ("memory_sync_records"."scope" = 'household' AND "memory_sync_records"."member_id" IS NULL AND "memory_sync_records"."planning_run_id" IS NULL) OR ("memory_sync_records"."scope" = 'member' AND "memory_sync_records"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_sync_records"."planning_run_id" IS NULL) OR ("memory_sync_records"."scope" = 'planning_run' AND "memory_sync_records"."member_id" IS NULL AND "memory_sync_records"."planning_run_id" IS NOT NULL)

shopping_proposal_items_decision_consist.name: shopping_proposal_items_decision_consistency
shopping_proposal_items_decision_consist.value: ("shopping_proposal_items"."final_decision_at" IS NULL AND "shopping_proposal_items"."final_decision_by_member_id" IS NULL) OR ("shopping_proposal_items"."final_decision_at" IS NOT NULL AND "shopping_proposal_items"."final_decision_by_member_id" IS NOT NULL)

shopping_proposals_approval_consistency.name: shopping_proposals_approval_consistency
shopping_proposals_approval_consistency.value: ("shopping_proposals"."status" <> 'approved' AND "shopping_proposals"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "shopping_proposals"."approved_by_member_id" IS NULL) OR ("shopping_proposals"."status" IN ('approved', 'applied') AND "shopping_proposals"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "shopping_proposals"."approved_by_member_id" IS NOT NULL)
